summary: migration_bridge.py materializes fixed RED-test templates for slices R0/R1/R2 only; CLI requires repository-root, plan-dir, slice-id, snapshot-path, materialize-only; rejects unsupported slices or non-materialize use; writes only declared test paths and aborts on differing existing content; outputs JSON test_paths with empty authorizes; R0 asserts v3 coordinator reaches bundle validation error; R1 asserts identical successor lineage reservation is idempotent and persists lineage; R2 asserts refresh_context_read_set exists in Quick Dev and acceptance knowledge-context modules; plan-dir and snapshot-path are parsed but unused; bridge itself creates directories/files, so execution requires write authority.
